Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Enable_tooltip: Survivors spawn from the map's spawn towns, persist across sessions, and act whether or not you are nearby.\nTurn off for a world without them.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_PopulationGove: Off: the population is sized automatically from the installed map\n(about 18 per spawn town, roughly 216 on the full map, so map mods add people automatically).\nOn: the number below is used instead.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Population_too: The number of living survivors maintained, used only when manual population is on.\nOnly nearby survivors have live bodies; the rest are simulated at low cost.\nAn existing world keeps the number it was created with and refills toward it over time.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_NewcomersGover: Off: the county can grow to three times the population as newcomers arrive.\nOn: the limit below is used instead.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Newcomers_tool: The maximum total population reachable through newcomer arrivals, used only when the manual limit is on.\nSet at or below the population to stop newcomer arrivals entirely.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadTraffic_to: How many people arrive together in a newcomer group. Groups arrive roughly once a month.\nWhether they settle depends on the county's wars, creeds, and season.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RoadPressureSt: How much the wait between newcomer groups shortens as the game goes on.\nAt None, arrivals stay about a month apart for the whole game.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_MaterializeRad: Survivors within this many tiles of you get a live body in the world.\nSurvivors farther away are simulated without a body.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HibernateRadiu: Live survivors farther than this many tiles from you return to simulation at their current position.\nKeep it comfortably above the presence radius, or survivors will appear and disappear repeatedly at the boundary.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays: Days before replacement after a death
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RefillDays_too: After a death, the county waits this many in-game days before a new survivor can spawn at a spawn town\n(never at the death site, never near you). At 0, replacement is immediate.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Desperation_to: The hunger or thirst level above which survivors take claimed food and water and ignore objections.\nLower values mean they take sooner; at the maximum they never take.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_TrustToCompany: The mutual trust level required before two survivors travel together (a trusted third can join).\nLower values form groups more easily.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Voice_tooltip: Survivors say short lines at meaningful moments: fleeing, warnings, thanks, grief.\nOff: identical behavior, no lines.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DayZero_toolti: The county starts before the outbreak: no fear, no losses, no learned lessons yet.\nPairs well with low zombie counts and slow turning.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_Telemetry_tool: Writes events (lessons learned, deaths, daily summaries) to SAO_telemetry.jsonl in your Zomboid folder.\nHas no effect on gameplay. Turn off if you do not want the file.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_DormantRisk_to: Death risk multiplier for survivors outside the loaded area.\n0 disables off-screen deaths. 1 matches the danger near you. Higher values are deadlier.\nRisk is reduced by learned lessons, group membership, and a hardened past.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_HoldNeighbourP: Suppresses overhead messages and narration from other survivor mods.\nHeld messages are counted on the County Ledger and released when this is turned off.\nThe same messages can usually also be disabled in those mods' own options.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RestoreTakenZo: Restore zombies taken by survivor spawns
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RecordOnCalend: Date broadcasts and newspapers by the calendar

The game's radio and TV schedule and its dated newspapers follow the in-game date instead of counting from the day the world began.
The Knox Event schedule starts July 9, 1993.
A world that starts earlier receives it from that date; a world that starts later receives it already in progress.
Newspapers show the newest issue printed by the current date.
Off: the schedule counts from the day the world began and newspapers are dated at random, as in the unmodded game.
Sandbox_SurvivorAwareness_RestoreTakenZo:
Each survivor spawn removes one nearby zombie, so the population is exchanged rather than added.
On: the county places one replacement zombie on distant town ground for each one taken, a few per day, never near you.
The map keeps the total it had, moved to where people crowded.
Off: taken zombies stay gone. The running balance is kept either way, so turning this on later repays gradually.
